The '''Ensos''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[near-Human]]s from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ensolica]]. They were acclimated to the arctic conditions of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], a planet of [[Water/Legends|ice]] sheets and frozen tundra with only a strip of temperate land along the equator. These adaptations made Ensos completely at home in sub-zero temperatures. Nevertheless, that cold resistance was matched by a vulnerability to high temperatures. In [[Desert/Legends|desert]] climates, such as that of the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Ensos were forced to wear awkward, full-body [[coolth suit]]s to avoid near-instant heatstroke.

Enso [[City/Legends|cities]] were carved into the ice of Ensolica. To maximize the productive capacity of a forbidding landscape and feed their population, the species mastered [[Hydroponics/Legends|hydroponics]] technology. Their breakthroughs in the field attracted the attention of such corporations as [[Alderaan Biotics]] and [[Tusus Comestibles]], who wooed Enso [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] and specialists to work for them across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:MosEspaSpacewoman.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Ensos had similar features to Humans.]]
The Ensos were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[near-Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="CSWE III 90" /> with bodies that appeared similar to those of baseline [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. For instance, members of the species had a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] body layout, featuring two [[Limb/Legends|arms]], two legs, and a head. The face appeared Human as well, with at least some Ensos sporting [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], blond hair, and pale skin. Ensos had two [[Gender/Legends|sexes]], male and female.<ref name="DB" />

Where Ensos differed from Humans was in their widely different range of temperature tolerance. Biological adaptations allowed Ensos to withstand frigid temperatures that would force baseline Humans to wear protective gear.<ref name="DB" /> Ensos had a naturally low body temperature,<ref name="CSWE I 237">{{CSWECite|I|237|Ensolica}}</ref> which made them most comfortable in sub-zero conditions.<ref name="CSWE III 90" /> However, that adaptation also made Ensos vulnerable to extremes of heat that a Human could have endured; Ensos visiting hot [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] had to wear protective suits to keep their body temperature down lest they suffer heatstroke after only brief exposure.<ref name="DB" />

==Society and culture==
Located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]],<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the arctic planet of [[Ensolica]] had a harsh climate that greatly affected Enso culture and society. Due to the predominance of [[Water/Legends|ice]] and tundra on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], the Ensos lived in [[City/Legends|cities]] dug out from the ice sheets. Their planet offered little arable land, so the species relied on their expertise in hydroponics technology to [[Farm/Legends|grow crops]]. The near-Humans had access to [[Starship/Legends|starships]] as well.<ref name="DB" />

==History==
The Ensos developed their biological resistance to cold as part of their adaptation to life on their homeworld, Ensolica. That planet was frigid and imposing, its tracts of tundra and ice giving way to [[Tree/Legends|coniferous]] forests only in the relatively temperate equatorial regions. The Ensos took to chiseling their cities out of the ice and mastered the science of hydroponics to keep themselves fed.<ref name="DB" /> After Ensolica became part of the [[galactic community]], the Ensos were considered to be citizens of the Core Worlds.<ref name="Atlas" /> Ensolica was located in [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Atlas" /> [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later, in [[137 ABY]], their homeworld fell within territory considered part of [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Atlas" />

==Ensos in the galaxy==
Due to the Ensos' expertise in the field, corporations such as [[Alderaan Biotics]] and [[Tusus Comestibles]] often hired the cream of Ensolica's hydroponics industry to work for them. Such positions frequently required Enso experts to leave their homeworld and travel throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="DB" />

[[File:TeyoraRekab-MosEspa.png|thumb|right|300px|The Enso Teyora Rekab spent time in Mos Espa on Tatooine.]]
One such professional was [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Teyora Rekab]], who led an Enso hydroponics crew. The group made their living selling hydroponic equipment and seeds, performing maintenance work on such devices, and acting as consultants. Rekab and her team frequently visited the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] world [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where they sold equipment and lent expertise to the local [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]].<ref name="DB" /> Rekab walked with another suited individual through the city of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on Tatooine<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]<ref>According to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' the events of {{Film|I}} take place in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> on the day the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] met the young Human [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. She later attended the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|annual]] [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|Podrace]] at the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]] on Tatooine.<ref name="TPM" />

When Ensos traveled to hot planets such as Tatooine, they had to rely upon [[coolth suit]]s to protect them from the scorching temperatures;<ref name="DB" /> a typical unit of this type used the chemical [[Coolth/Legends|coolth]] to control the wearer's temperature.<ref name="CSWE I 139">{{CSWECite|I|139|Coolth}}</ref> These full-body suits were clunky and unattractive, and many Ensos opted to simply rent them if absolutely necessary. Only the more expensive rental models offered humidity adjustment, dust filtering, and control over the suit's preset temperature. Many Ensos chose to wear polarized [[sun-goggles]] in tandem with such protective gear, since coolth suits offered little protection from glaring [[Star/Legends|suns]] common on hot worlds.<ref name="DB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Enso species was created for [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], released in [[1999]] as the first film of the [[prequel trilogy]].<ref name="TPM" /> In an entry published on [[January 12]], [[2007]],<ref name="What's The Story">{{SWArchive|url=databank/updates/news20070112.html|text=What's the Story: Episode I}}</ref> [[Nathan O'Keefe]],<ref name="ValinKenobi">{{Blog|listing=true|valinkenobi}}</ref><ref name="Tinker">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/praji/20090205.html|text=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji|int=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji}}</ref> writing as "Valin Kenobi," submitted an entry for Teyora Rekab, which first named her and her species, through the [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature "[[What's The Story?]]."<ref name="DB" />

In its entry for Captain Teyora Rekab, the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' gives her species' name as "Ensos."<ref name="CSWE III 90" /> As this conflicts with the [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry,<ref name="CSWE I 237" /> and the other entry in the encyclopedia,<ref name="DB" /> this is assumed to be an error; the Databank only uses ''Ensos'' as the plural of ''Enso''.<ref name="DB" />
